title: Mead Loose Leaf Paper, Wide Ruled Filler Notebook Paper, 8" x 10-1/2", 200 Sheets, Fits 3-Ring Binder (15200)

reviews.title: Affordable fountain pen friendly loose-leaf paper
reviews.body: I was looking for a cheap paper option which is fountain pen friendly. Copier papers, even much thicker (I've tried up to 120gsm), are usually too absorbent to work nicely with fountain pens, and the writing looks very flat. Also think papers are harder to work in some cases.This paper is quite thin but has a polished feel. I used broadest nibs (double broad) and I could still use other side of the paper (although I use only one side as a personal preference). There is no feathering in most of the nib/ ink combinations. Since this paper is already punched, I can organize them in file.Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Mukesh Chakravarti

reviews.author: Jennifer Chávez

reviews.title: Great find!
reviews.body: I bought this Mead Loose Leaf Paper 3-pack for my 5th grader, and it has been perfect for school use. The wide-ruled spacing is just right for younger students who are still developing their handwriting, making it easier for them to write neatly and stay within the lines.The paper quality is solid and holds up well to daily classroom use. It doesn’t tear easily when being removed from binders, and it works well with pencils, pens, and even some markers without too much bleed-through. Having 200 sheets per pack is also a great value, especially since kids go through paper quickly during the school year.I like that the pages are standard size and fit perfectly in a 3-ring binder, which helps keep homework and classwork organized. The packs are convenient to store and last a long time, which saves frequent trips to the store.The only minor downside is that the paper is fairly basic and thin compared to premium stationery, but for schoolwork it is exactly what is needed.Overall, this is a reliable and affordable school supply that works perfectly for elementary students. I would definitely recommend it for everyday classroom use.
